definitions.explanation: A state of feeling sad, pessimistic, or emotionally down.

examples.japanese: {憂鬱|ゆううつ}な{気分|きぶん}だ。
{月曜日|げつようび}は{憂鬱|ゆううつ}だ。

notes:
{憂鬱|ゆううつ} is a na-adjective and noun describing a state of feeling depressed, gloomy, or melancholic.

KANJI NOTE:
The character {鬱|うつ} has 29 strokes, making it one of the most complex kanji in common use. Often written in hiragana (ゆううつ) or with the simplified variant {欝|うつ}.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {憂鬱|ゆううつ}な{気分|きぶん}: depressed mood
- {憂鬱|ゆううつ}になる: to become depressed
- {憂鬱|ゆううつ}な{天気|てんき}: gloomy weather
- {憂鬱|ゆううつ}を{感|かん}じる: to feel melancholy

RELATED MEDICAL TERMS:
- うつ{病|びょう}: clinical depression
- {抑|よく}うつ: depression (technical)
- うつ{状態|じょうたい}: depressive state

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {暗|くら}い: dark, gloomy (mood)
- {沈|しず}んだ: sunken, depressed
- ブルー: blue, feeling down (casual)
